title: Real-content FTX creditor matrix extraction schema
description: Extract the case header and every creditor row from the FTX Consolidated List of Creditors. Rows are a fully-ruled nine-column table with a gold header band; many cells are blank and many rows are redacted to 'NAME ON FILE' / 'ADDRESS ON FILE'. Return creditors in document (alphabetical) order; preserve the redaction tokens verbatim; use null for any blank cell.

report_title.description: Document title printed on each content page, e.g. 'Consolidated List of Creditors'.

case_number.description: Bankruptcy case number from the ECF filing stamp, e.g. '22-11068-JTD'.

debtor.description: Debtor named in the caption, e.g. 'FTX Trading Ltd., et al.'.

creditors.description: Every creditor row in document order. Preserve 'NAME ON FILE' / 'ADDRESS ON FILE' verbatim; use null for blank cells.

name.description: Creditor name (first column); may be 'NAME ON FILE'.

address_1.description: First address line (or 'ADDRESS ON FILE'), else null.

country.description: Country (blank for domestic US rows), else null.

source_page.description: One-indexed PDF page where the row is printed.
